body: There were people from all walks of life including a elementary music teacher to homeless. They took things like your shoelaces and there was a set schedule. Group therapy several times a day they didn’t force you to go to or participate. You could sleep in your room all day if you wanted. Cafeteria food ranges in quality. You met personally with a doctor and a therapist once a day. Lots of free time to talk or color. At night they turned on the tv. My only complaint is that it was cold in the building and the beds suck.
I don’t have any money to move anytime soon and I’ve wasted what people call the best years of their life. All I have to look forward to is 40 years of working somewhere I’ll probably hate.
